title: 金字塔加仓：趋势单怎么越涨越加才不翻车
subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。
#加仓 #交易干货 #仓位 #BTC #ETH

translatedData.title: Pyramid Scaling: How to Add to a Winning Trend Trade Without Blowing Up
translatedData.subTitle:
You’ve correctly spotted the trend and want to add to your position—but how? Going in heavy right away and adding until you’re fully loaded with floating profits is a recipe for landing on the liquidation list.
A common sight. The right approach is called pyramid scaling.

【Principle】Each time you add to your position, add less than the previous time. For example, start with 30%, then add 20% after the first pullback is confirmed,
After confirmation, add another 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position should be. Keep most of your cost basis low so you can weather a pullback.

【Why the reverse is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, adding more and more at the top) means your
average cost is concentrated at the top. Even a slight pullback can turn your profits into losses. Once you lose your nerve, every move goes wrong.

Hong Kong plans licensing for four types of virtual asset services: trading, custody, advisory and asset management

Hong Kong’s virtual asset regulation is moving from a focus on exchanges to coverage of the entire value chain. First, some background: in 2021, the Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau (FSTB) consulted the market on a licensing regime for virtual asset service providers. The regime took effect on June 1, 2023, under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance. Exchanges must be licensed by the Securities and Futures Commission (SFC), and subsequent amendments also allowed overseas companies registered under the Companies Ordinance to apply for licences. Intermediaries, meanwhile, have been able to expand their business by upgrading their Type 1, 4 or 9 licences under the Securities and Futures Ordinance. But over-the-counter exchange, research and asset management firms that deal exclusively in virtual assets and do not touch securities have long operated in a regulatory gap. The key facts are these: on December 24, 2025, the FSTB and the SFC published consultation conclusions on licensing for virtual asset trading, while launching further consultations on two new licences—for providing advice on virtual assets and for managing virtual assets. Together with the previously published consultation conclusions on virtual asset custody services, this means Hong Kong plans to establish separate licences for four types of services: trading, custody, advice and asset management. The bill is expected to be submitted to the Legislative Council for consideration in 2026. Three aspects of the regime’s design merit closer examination. First, the boundaries are clear: derivatives and structured products linked to virtual assets, as well as tokenised securities, are excluded from the new licences and will remain regulated under Types 1, 2 and 11 licences under the Securities and Futures Ordinance, avoiding duplicate licensing. Second, custody requirements are being tightened: dealers must place client assets with custodians regulated by the SFC. Third, regulatory arbitrage is being blocked: the proposed virtual asset management regime will have no exemption based on a minimum investment threshold, so a licence will be required regardless of the size of a firm’s exposure, preventing firms from deliberately keeping allocations low to evade regulation. None of the three new licences will have a transition period or deemed-licence arrangements. Firms already holding upgraded Type 1, 4 or 9 licences, as well as entities affiliated with licensed platforms, may qualify for expedited approval. The impact on the crypto market can be viewed on two levels. As a matter of fact, recognised institutions such as banks will not be exempt: they must register with the SFC and be subject to frontline supervision by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority. Street-level money changers, over-the-counter exchange platforms, firms conducting research solely on virtual assets, and managers whose portfolios consist entirely of digital assets are all explicitly included within the scope of licensing. As for potential effects, the licensing threshold may drive smaller service providers out of the market and concentrate activity among larger firms. Demand for specialised services such as compliant custody and anti-money-laundering systems may emerge first. If execution channels are permitted to extend beyond licensed exchanges to other approved platforms, liquidity and service costs could improve, but this depends on assessments of the credibility of overseas platforms and remains undecided. Editorial assessment: this framework continues the principle of “same business, same risks, same rules.” In the short term, it will test the industry’s ability to comply; in the long term, it will provide the institutional foundation for an orderly entry of institutional capital. The real variables are the legislative timetable and how the detailed rules are implemented. The original regulatory documents should be treated as authoritative, and settled measures distinguished from matters still under consultation.

content:
香港拟对虚拟资产交易托管顾问资管四类服务发牌

香港的虚拟资产监管正从交易所单点突破走向全链条覆盖。先看背景：财库局于2021年公布就虚拟资产服务提供者发牌制度咨询市场，相关制度于2023年6月1日在《打击洗钱及恐怖分子资金筹集条例》框架下生效，交易所须获证监会发牌，后续修订还允许依《公司条例》注册的海外公司申请牌照；中介机构则依托《证券及期货条例》第1、4、9类牌照升级开展业务，仅服务虚拟资产而不触及证券的场外找换、研究与资管机构长期存在监管空窗。核心事实是：2025年12月24日，财库局与证监会就虚拟资产交易牌照发布咨询总结，同时就虚拟资产提供意见、虚拟资产管理两项新牌照展开进一步咨询；结合已发布的虚拟资产托管服务咨询总结，香港拟对交易、托管、意见、资管四类服务分别设立专项牌照，条例草案预期2026年提交立法会审议。制度设计有三点值得拆解。一是划界清晰：与虚拟资产挂钩的衍生品、结构性产品及代币化证券被排除在新牌之外，仍按《证券及期货条例》第1、2、11类监管，避免重复发牌；二是托管收紧，交易商必须将客户资产交由受证监会监管的托管人保管；三是堵住套利，虚拟资产管理拟不设最低投资比例豁免，无论敞口多少均须持牌，防止机构刻意压低配置规避监管。同时，三项新牌均不设过渡期与视为持牌安排，已持升级1、4、9号牌的机构及持牌平台关联实体可适用加快审批。对加密市场的影响可分两层：事实层面，银行等认可机构不获豁免，须向证监会注册并接受金管局前线监管，街头找换店、场外兑换平台、纯币种研究与全仓数字资产管理者均被明确纳入发牌范围；推测层面，牌照门槛或推动中小服务商出清与头部集中，合规托管、反洗钱系统等专业配套需求有望先行，若执行渠道获准延伸至持牌交易所之外的受审查平台，流动性与服务成本存在改善空间，但这取决于对海外平台可信度的评估，仍属未定事项。编辑判断：这套框架延续相同业务、相同风险、相同规则的思路，短期是行业合规压力测试，长期是机构资金有序进场的制度前提，真正变量在立法节奏与细则落地，宜以监管文件原文为准，区分已定案内容与仍在咨询事项。

Several participants also discussed the risk of a repricing of AI assets. Staff also noted that banks and households have buffers on their balance sheets, and that the financial system remains resilient overall. These are risk scenarios discussed at the meeting—not an AI debt crisis that has already occurred, nor an announcement of a new interest-rate decision.

The connection to ETH is through the transmission of capital, not a problem with the Ethereum protocol itself. If stocks and credit bonds come under pressure, funds seeking to deleverage or meet redemptions may sell volatile assets, potentially weighing on ETH along with broader risk assets. Conversely, if risk appetite recovers, macro pressure could ease quickly. Farside currently lists total net outflows of $131.2 million from U.S. spot Ethereum funds on November 19, including $124.2 million in net outflows from ETHA. These are yesterday’s fund flow figures; they don’t mean the same amount of selling is happening every minute today. ETH/USDT on Binance was around $1,753 just now, down about 3% over 24 hours, with a range of $1,718 to $1,818. The market has already reflected some pressure, but a simultaneous decline alone doesn’t prove that the meeting minutes caused all of it. Earlier reports about CFTC event contracts also cannot offset spot fund outflows or substitute for actual demand.

On price, I’ll first watch whether the 24-hour low near $1,718 holds, then whether ETH can reclaim $1,780. The area around $1,818 is the stricter test of the upper range. If price repeatedly falls back below $1,780, any rebound is still just a recovery within the range. I’ll only raise my short-term outlook if price breaks above $1,818 and holds on a retest, while fund flows improve. If ETH breaks below $1,718 on rising volume, that would reinforce the need for caution. The Fed minutes discuss conditional risks; if subsequent data, credit spreads, and fund flows contradict my current thesis, I’ll revise my conclusion promptly.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t participate right now. I’d stay on the sidelines and wait, without using leverage. Any exploratory long position would be capped at 5% of total capital, and I’d enter in stages only after ETH/USDT holds above $1,780 and confirms the level on a retest, with an initial target of $1,818. Standard Chartered set a target price of 4,000 for ETH, with a time frame of “a little over a month.” On the same day, ETH fell 3.00% to $1,750.59. Put these two numbers together and the contradiction is obvious: 4,000 implies a 128% rise from the current price, while perpetual futures say otherwise, with a funding rate of 0.0061% every 8 hours, or about 6.7% annualized. If anyone really believed ETH could more than double in five weeks, bulls would be scrambling to pay to hold their positions, and the rate would already have been pushed up to 0.02%–0.03%. The current situation is this: investment banks are making the call, but leveraged capital isn’t following.

The second thing that doesn’t add up is the 71.3% share of accounts that are long. More than 70% of accounts are on the long side, yet the funding rate is only 0.0061%. Read these two figures together and the picture is clear: lots of people, not much money. The long side is mostly crowded with small retail accounts; the big money that can actually move prices hasn’t paid a premium to build positions. The most typical outcome for this kind of setup isn’t an upward breakout. It’s either a sideways grind until the bulls give up, or a single red candle that sweeps all their stops. That post in the community about a 10U position suffering a 93% drawdown is the real-world result of this setup.

The third dimension is trading volume and open interest. 24-hour trading volume is 9.95 billion USDT, open interest is 4.354 billion USDT, and turnover is around 2.3 times. That’s not exactly quiet, but read alongside a 3% drop, it looks more like someone used the day the target price was all over the headlines to offload their holdings. Who are investment bank reports for? The side that needs liquidity. The louder the target price call, the easier it is to sell.

There’s another point people don’t often connect 📌 The investigation into the tampering incident involving Ledger hardware wallets has now reached Berlin. This news and the “ETH is going to 4,000” post were both trending on the same day. On one hand, you’re told there’s still 128% upside; on the other, you’re told even cold wallets may have been tampered with. Retail traders are caught in the middle, encouraged to increase their positions while being reminded that even self-custody isn’t absolutely safe. This combination of emotions fuels high-frequency bad decisions, not a trend.

My take: 4,000 isn’t a pipe dream, but it’s not something to buy at the current price structure. There are two signals worth waiting for. First, the funding rate needs to rise from 0.0061% to above 0.02%, showing that real money is willing to pay to be long. Second, the share of long accounts needs to fall from 71.3% toward 60%, indicating that weak hands have been shaken out. Until both of these happen, the target price looks more like someone else’s sales pitch than a reason for you to enter.

Before chasing a move at this level, think about one thing: if the price falls back to 1,650, whose positions will get liquidated?

#币圈 #ETH #Crypto

content:
渣打给 ETH 挂了个 4000 的目标价，时间窗口「一个多月」，同一天 ETH 跌 3.00%，报 1750.59。这两个数字放在一起，不难看出矛盾：4000 意味着从现价往上 128%，而永续合约那边给出的答案是每 8 小时 0.0061% 的资金费率，年化 6.7% 左右。真要有人相信五周能翻一倍多，多头会抢着付钱占住仓位，费率早就被顶到 0.02%–0.03% 了。现在的局面是，投行在喊，杠杆资金没跟。

第二个不对劲的地方是多头账户占比 71.3%。七成以上的账户站在多头一侧，但费率只有 0.0061%。这两个数一起看，画面很清楚：人多，钱不大。挤在多头侧的基本是散户小账户，真正能推价格的大资金并没有付出溢价去建仓。这种结构最典型的结局不是往上突破，是横盘磨到多头自己认输，或者一根阴线把止损全扫掉。广场上那个 10U 仓位回撤 93% 的帖子，就是这个结构下的真实结果。

第三个维度看成交和持仓。24 小时成交 99.5 亿 USDT，持仓量 43.54 亿 USDT，换手 2.3 倍左右。这个量不算冷清，但配合下跌 3% 一起读，更像是有人在目标价刷屏的当天把货递出去。投行报告是给谁看的？给需要流动性的那一方看的。目标价喊得越响亮，出货就越顺。

还有一个不太被连起来看的点 📌 Ledger 的硬件钱包篡改事件已经查到柏林。这条新闻和「ETH 要涨到 4000」是同一天的热帖。一边告诉你还有 128% 的空间，一边告诉你连冷钱包都可能被动过手脚。散户夹在中间，既被鼓励加大仓位，又被提醒连自己保管资产都不绝对安全，这种情绪组合催生的不是趋势，而是高频的错误决策。

我的看法：4000 不是天方夜谭，但它不是用现在这个价格结构去买的东西。真正值得等的是两个信号。一是资金费率从 0.0061% 抬到 0.02% 以上，说明有真实资金愿意为多头付费；二是多头账户占比从 71.3% 回落向 60% 附近，说明浮筹被洗掉了。这两个都没出现之前，目标价更像是别人的出货话术，而不是你的入场理由。

追这种位置之前先想一件事：如果跌回 1650，爆的是谁的仓。

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Rule: Why You Have to Afford Losing to Stay in the Game
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been discussed to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on any single trade
should not exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 U in starting capital, 2% means you can lose at most 200 U on a single trade. After 10 losses in a row, you’d still have 8,000,
If your account is down just 20%, a few winning trades can get you back on track. By contrast, if you go all-in every time and lose 30%,
three losses in a row leave you with just 34% of your capital—you'd need to nearly double it just to break even. Mathematically, you're basically done for.

【How to put it into practice】It’s not “keep your position size under 2%.” It’s “the amount you lose if this trade hits your stop-loss
must not exceed 2%.” So the correct order is: find your stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work backward to determine your position size.

In-depth technical knowledge: The EIP-1559 fee mechanism
The more congested the network, the more the base fee increases, and the more ETH gets burned. The amount burned compared with the amount newly issued determines whether the ETH supply increases or decreases during that period.
For transactions that aren't urgent, you can set a lower priority fee; for urgent transactions, raise it appropriately. Don't set it too high without good reason.

title: 分批止盈：落袋为安和让利润奔跑，怎么兼得
subTitle:
止盈比止损难，因为止损砍的是恐惧，止盈砍的是贪婪。行情越好你越不想
卖，一回调又后悔没跑。分享我一直在用的分批止盈。

【三段式】第一段：到第一个目标位（比如1倍盈亏比）减仓1/3，先落袋，
这时候这笔单已经不会亏了，心态立刻不一样。第二段：到第二目标位
（比如2倍盈亏比）再减1/3。第三段：剩下的用移动止损跟，跌破均线
或前低就走，让利润自己跑。

【为什么这样】全仓跑早了会拍大腿，全仓拿着经常坐电梯回到解放前。
分批的本质是把「卖在最高点」这个不可能任务，拆成三笔还不错的决策。

【关键动作】减仓之后把止损上移到成本价，这就是传说中的「免费单」。
手里的利润单，最怕的就是抱着抱着变成亏损单。

translatedData.title: Scaling out: How to lock in profits while letting them run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than cutting losses, because a stop loss cuts fear while taking profit cuts greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell—and when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here's the scale-out strategy I've been using.

【Three stages】Stage one: at the first target (for example, a 1:1 reward-to-risk ratio), reduce your position by a third and lock in some profits,
At this point, the trade can no longer lose money, and your mindset immediately changes. Stage two: at the second target
(for example, a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio), sell another third. Stage three: trail the stop on the remainder and exit if the price drops below the moving average
or the previous swing low. Let your profits run.

【Why this works】Sell everything too early and you'll kick yourself; hold everything and you'll often ride the elevator right back down to where you started.

Blockchain Industry | What exactly is a blob, and why can it reduce Layer 2 fees?
Blobs have their own fee market: the blob base fee adjusts automatically based on the gap between usage and the target, and it is also burned.
Blobs are cheap because their data is retained for only about 18 days, rather than stored permanently, and is not used in EVM computations, which places a much lighter burden on nodes.
When Layer 2 networks write blob data to the mainnet, they also pay the blob fee in $ETH . The current price is 1755.19.
Make sure you understand the rules before taking action. Don’t place an order on impulse.

Don’t rush to memorize the definition: what exactly is a blob, and how can it lower Layer 2 fees?
EIP-4844 introduced a new type of transaction that carries blobs. Each blob contains 4096 data units of 32 bytes each, or about 128 KB.
The Fusaka upgrade in December 2025 introduced PeerDAS, which lets nodes sample-check only part of the blob data. The blob limit was raised afterward as well.
When comparing transaction fees across Layer 2 networks, distinguish between the Layer 2 network’s own execution fees and the cost of submitting data to the mainnet. Both can change.
When a Layer 2 network writes blob data to the mainnet, the blob fee is also paid in $ETH .

[XRP Futures Average Daily Trading Volume Tops $216M—Why Are Institutions Suddenly Getting Into Regulated XRP?]

CME's XRP futures have reached an average daily trading volume of $216 million, showing that institutions are starting to take regulated cryptocurrencies seriously.

Last week, there was news that CME's XRP futures had reached an average daily trading volume of $216 million. That's a pretty impressive figure. After all, institutions used to get into crypto either by buying coins directly or trading over the counter. Now, they're actually willing to buy futures contracts on a regulated exchange like CME. It's like giving the crypto market an “official entry pass,” letting institutions get exposure to these assets without having to do it under the table. Why the sudden surge in popularity? It may have something to do with the US regulatory climate. The SEC used to keep a close eye on these exchanges, but now regulated platforms like CME have become particularly attractive. Futures trading has expiration dates, after all, so in theory it's a little less risky than buying coins directly. Institutions also like that sense of being “in control.”

Impact on the market
- Short term: This news is positive for sentiment around XRP, but the impact won't be especially large, since futures and spot markets aren't that closely correlated. More importantly, it could draw some capital back from over-the-counter trading into regulated markets, boosting liquidity across the crypto market as a whole.
- Medium term: If this trend continues, regulators might start thinking, “Hey, maybe crypto isn't so bad after all,” and become more lenient when approving ETFs. But the threat of tighter regulation is still there in the short term, so institutions won't all rush in at once.

My take
I think this is more a case of rising tides lifting all boats. Institutional demand for crypto has always been there; the problem was that there wasn't a proper channel before. Now that CME has opened the door, of course they'll want to join in. But it's too early to say this will completely change the market landscape. In the short term, it would be good if XRP could hold at $0.97. In the medium to long term, we'll have to see whether the US introduces any genuinely positive policies. Don't come down too hard on me if I'm wrong—I'm only testing the waters with a small position myself. I'm about 70% confident in this assessment; I'll leave the other 30% up to the market.

CME的XRP期货日均成交额达2.16亿美元，说明机构开始认真对待合规的加密货币。

上周有个新闻说CME的XRP期货日均成交额到2.16亿美元了，这数字挺惊人的。要知道，以前机构搞加密货币，要么直接买币，要么玩场外交易，现在居然愿意在CME这种正规交易所买期货合约。这相当于给加密货币市场开了个"正规入场券"，让机构不用再偷偷摸摸就能接触这类资产。为啥突然这么火？可能跟美国监管态度有点关系，之前SEC老盯着这些交易所，现在CME这种受监管的平台反而成了香饽饽。毕竟期货交易有交割日限制，理论上比直接买币风险低点，机构也喜欢这种"受控"的感觉。

对市场的影响
- 短期：这个消息对XRP情绪是利好，但幅度不会特别大，毕竟期货和现货关联度没这么高。更关键的是，它可能会吸引部分资金从场外交易回流到合规市场，对整个加密货币市场的流动性有提振作用。
- 中期：如果这种趋势持续，可能会让监管机构觉得"嘿，加密货币也不是那么坏"，从而在ETF审批上更松。但短期内，监管收紧的阴影还是存在的，所以机构不会一下子全冲进来。

我的判断
我觉得这更多是水涨船高的事儿，机构投资加密货币的需求一直都在，只是以前没个正规渠道。现在CME开了个口子，他们自然要凑热闹。但要说能彻底改变市场格局，现在还为时过早。短期看XRP能稳住0.97这个价位就不错了，中长期还得看美国那边有没有实质性的利好政策出台。说错轻喷，我自己也就小仓位试试，这判断我有七成把握，剩下三成交给市场。

Private credit NAVs update only once a quarter. If the underlying assets have already gone rotten, are the RWA tokens in your hands still worth anything?

$ETH  quotes jump every second, but RWA’s stagnant prices are the most deceptive. The books look rock-solid, while liquidity has actually dried up.

This is a classic case of information asymmetry. Algorithms mistake “no volatility” for “safe.” By the time the oracle catches on, the liquidation market is already empty.

The biggest risk to this logic is a sudden flood of transparency about the underlying data triggering a bank run. Don’t be fooled by today’s stable prices—first keep a close eye out for signs that large holders are pulling out.

title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

translatedData.title: Where should you place your stop-loss? Here’s how I choose between technical levels and percentages
translatedData.subTitle:
Where you place your stop-loss matters even more than whether you set one. Place it too close and it’ll get triggered every day; too far away and one loss can hurt badly.

【Fixed-percentage method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. It’s simple and straightforward, and suitable for beginners
to build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop might land right in a cluster of other traders’ stops.

【Technical-level stop-loss method】Place it where the structure would be invalidated: for a long position, below key support; for a short position,
above resistance. The logic is: if this level breaks, it’s evidence that I was wrong.
Adjust your position size based on the stop distance: the wider the stop, the smaller the position, so the loss on any single trade remains

A protocol changed its contract logic overnight. Are the assets users deposited still safe?
One number: during an upgrade, an account with upgrade privileges changes which new logic contract the proxy contract points to. The address users interact with stays the same, but the logic being executed changes.
Many protocols entrust upgrade privileges to multisig wallets or governance votes, and then set a time lock. Upgrades take some time to go into effect, giving users time to withdraw.
Remember this—it’s more useful than memorizing a bunch of jargon. Take the time to understand how things work before you act; don’t place orders on impulse.

title: 资金费率里藏着多空情绪，教你读三种典型状态
subTitle:
上次讲了资金费率的机制，今天讲怎么把它当情绪温度计用。

【状态一：费率持续高正】说明多头拥挤，大家都借钱做多。这时候行情
往往在加速赶顶阶段，随时可能来一次「多杀多」的急跌。不是让你立刻
做空，而是：这个阶段追多要格外小心，止损要收紧。

【状态二：费率持续负】空头拥挤。极端负费率经常出现在恐慌底部附近，
因为该跑的都跑了还在做空。历史上不少大反弹就起点在这种时候。

【状态三：费率在零附近晃】多空平衡，市场在等方向。这种时候趋势
策略最好歇着，区间思路或观望更合适。

【提醒】费率是温度计，不是方向盘。它告诉你现在谁挤，不告诉你下一
根K线涨跌。把它和你的技术面信号叠着看，别单独当买卖依据。

translatedData.subTitle:
Last time, we covered how funding rates work. Today, we'll look at how to use them as a sentiment gauge.

[State 1: Funding rates stay strongly positive] This means longs are crowded, with everyone borrowing money to go long. At this point, the market
is often accelerating toward a peak, and a sharp drop from a long squeeze could happen at any moment. That doesn't mean you should immediately
...but rather: be extra cautious about going long at this stage, and tighten your stop-loss.

[State 2: Funding rates stay negative] Shorts are crowded. Extremely negative funding rates often appear near panic-driven bottoms,
because everyone who was going to get out already has, yet people are still shorting. Many major rallies in the past started at times like this.

**重点话题**

1. **亚洲周五风险资产齐跌，日经盘中有口径跌约 4%，比特币一度看到约 61,000** — 昨夜美股高开低走之后，白天关注流把焦点转到亚洲盘的跟跌。BlockBeats 等写，日经 225 盘中跌幅扩大至约 4%，软银集团暴跌约 14%，铠侠跌近 10%；韩国 KOSPI 跌超 4%，三星电子跌约 4.4%，SK 海力士跌约 6%。_FORAB 把这一天概括成黄金、白银、上证、日经、韩综和比特币同步下跌，并指向 AI 泡沫论叠加加息预期、流动性更稀缺。对昨夜美股的补记也在继续传：有口径写标普 500 收跌 2.02%、连续 6 个交易日下跌，较 10 月 6 日高点回撤约 8.2%；纳指收跌约 2.25%；道指有帖写成下跌约 1,101 点并跌破 5 万点；英伟达盘中一度涨约 4.7%，最终收跌约 3.3%，AMD 有口径暴跌约 7.7%。KobeissiLetter 则称，美国科技股估值已降至 2020 年 3 月以来最低。

2. **Anthropic 上市余波：创始人开盘抛售被写成约 19–20 亿美元，配售争议和认亏帖一起出来** — 首日高开低走之后，白天讨论转到抛压和谁没拿到筹码。williamlab 称之为“黑色星期五”，称几位创始人开盘即抛售，从市场抽走约 20 亿美元；另有帖更细写成 7 位创始人出售约 2,300 万股、合计约 19 亿美元。_FORAB 转述彭博与 WSJ：约 1,200 家机构提交认购，超过一半没有拿到；招股书写最多 20% 给散户，实际约 15%；澳洲金融评论称当地投资者平均只拿到申购量的约 7%，标题直接用了 Brutal。他还援引 NBC：员工首日获准卖出 10% 持股，也被用来解释抛压。qinbafrank 回顾开盘：没有破发，冲高后回落、成交巨大，链上合约再一次接近给出开盘定价，但他认为 ANT 作为更直接的 AI 标的，会从硬件、云和软件里吸走一部分注意力，并提醒约 27 天后迎来第一批解锁。Arthur Hayes 发帖称市场不买账这次 IPO，自己认亏，等待更好的做多位置；_FORAB 补充，他 11 月 16 日看涨时盘前合约约 100 美元，昨夜冲高约 114 后回落，被写成跌回夜盘约 91 美元、低于其做多价。Solana 官方则称，自纳斯达克上市以来，链上 ANT 成交已超过 8,000 万美元，交易笔数约为 Robinhood Chain 的 10 倍。

3. **比特币跌破 62,000 后下看 60,000 清算区，有大户在 62,180 附近用 40 倍杠杆做多** — 昨夜还在 62,000 一带争夺，白天有交易贴写再次测试后跌破。wolfyxbt 看到约 61,000 时直接叫了出来；CoinAnk 一度记录低点约 61,207，此后仍在 61,500 附近徘徊，上方较强清算带被写在约 64,100–64,600。Bitwux 称 62,000 击穿后，60,000 是 Glassnode 标记的多头清算密集区下沿，并把技术面写成死叉、RSI 约 21.3、AHR999 约 0.29 的“全面投降区”。EmberCN 监测到知名交易员 AguilaTrades 在 Hyperliquid 上以约 40 倍杠杆做多 1,500 枚比特币（约 9,358 万美元），开多价 62,180，清算价 60,481。KillaXBT 提醒，留意比特币会不会再次抢跑低位清算，类似 2023 年在 10,000–12,000 一带的情形；BigCheds 则说 4 小时图上多头仍组织不起像样的防守。另有帖梳理，微策略（现名 Strategy）持有约 850,849 枚比特币，平均成本约 75,452 美元，按当时价格浮亏接近 110 亿美元。

translatedData.content:
ETH Price Event Contract Filing｜A $1 Contract Is Not Spot Buying｜I’m Still Waiting for 1,780

My stance is to remain cautious: first read the new derivatives filing carefully, then discuss ETH’s direction. Public records from the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission show that Rothera Exchange and Clearing self-certified an ETH price event contract on November 16. The filing states that it is intended to launch on or after November 18. The product settles based on whether Ethereum’s price in U.S. dollars at a specified time reaches a certain strike price. Each contract has a notional value of $1, and its trading price ranges from $0.01 to $0.99; the filing specifies $40 strike intervals for daily and weekly contracts. The listed reference price is the CF Benchmarks CME CF Ether-Dollar Real-Time Index. A public filing only confirms that product rules were submitted. The phrase “on or after” does not, by itself, establish how much trading has taken place at this moment—let alone mean that the CFTC specifically approved an ETH rally.

Why does this matter for market analysis? Event contracts offer another way to express short-term price expectations, potentially concentrating expectations, hedging, and liquidity around specific strike prices. But their dollar notional value and settlement outcomes are not equivalent to holding one ETH, and not every contract trade requires a corresponding purchase of ETH spot. If market makers hedge in other markets, the transmission depends on positioning, hedging methods, and timing. Calling this “new ETH spot ETF inflows” or “on-chain user growth” would be wrong. For a prudent trader, it is more useful to verify the launch status, actual trading volume, and open interest, then see whether the spot price confirms the move as well.

The market has not provided sufficient confirmation so far. At the time of writing, ETH/USDT on Binance is around $1,748, down about 3.3% over the past 24 hours, with a low of $1,717.82 and a high of $1,817.57. U.S. spot ETH funds saw combined net outflows of about $131.2 million on November 19, which is inconsistent with the claim that “a new derivatives filing immediately brought sustained spot buying.” Of course, the decline cannot be directly attributed to this filing, and ETF flows reflect only a single trading day. I previously discussed corporate ETH holdings and adjustments to the listing rules for existing ETFs; my new view today is that price event contracts change the tools for expressing expectations, not ETH’s supply or the mechanism for fund subscriptions.

I’m continuing to watch 1,718, 1,750, 1,780, and 1,818. 1,718 is the 24-hour low; if the price breaks below it and fails to recover, I won’t talk about buying the dip. A recovery above 1,750 would indicate some short-term support. Only a sustained hold above 1,780 accompanied by improving fund flows would make the rebound more credible. 1,818 is the previous high and resistance. If actual trading in the contracts becomes active, spot funds flow back in at the same time, and the price moves above 1,780, I will reconsider my current wait-and-see stance. If derivatives activity heats up but ETH still falls below 1,718, I’ll remain defensive.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now and only consider a conditional spot long. I would open a trial position using 2% of total capital only if ETH holds above 1,780, successfully retests it, and subsequent full-day ETF flows no longer deteriorate significantly. The first target is 1,818; I would take half off there and let the rest run toward 1,850. I would set a stop below 1,750 and keep the account risk on any single trade below 0.3%. If the price falls below 1,718, loses 1,750 again after a breakout, or actual contract data contradicts optimistic expectations, I would cancel the plan or close the entire position. I would not use high leverage or treat the filing as evidence of institutional demand that has already materialized.

#ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

ETH价格事件合约申报｜一美元合约非现货买盘｜我继续等1780

我的态度是保持谨慎，先把新衍生品文件读清，再谈ETH方向。美国商品期货交易委员会公开档案显示，Rothera Exchange and Clearing在11月16日自我认证一项ETH价格事件合约，文件写明拟于11月18日或之后推出。产品按指定时间的以太坊美元价格是否达到某个执行价结算，合约名义价值为1美元，交易价格在0.01至0.99美元之间；日度与周度合约的执行价间隔写为40美元。文件列出的参考价来源是CF Benchmarks的CME CF以太坊美元实时指数。公开申报只能证明产品规则被提交，不能仅凭“或之后”推断此刻已经有多少成交，更不能说CFTC专门批准了ETH上涨。

为什么这会影响市场观察？事件合约为短线价格预期提供另一条表达渠道，可能让特定执行价附近的预期、对冲和流动性更集中。但它的美元名义额和结算结果不等于持有一枚ETH，也不要求每一笔合约交易都直接买入同等价值的ETH现货。若做市商在其他市场对冲，传导会受持仓方向、对冲方式和时间影响。把它称作“新增ETH现货ETF资金”或“链上用户增长”都错了。对稳健交易员，更有用的是核查上线状态、真实成交量和未平仓量，再看现货价格是否同步确认。

市场目前没有给出充分确认。写稿时币安ETH/USDT约1748美元，过去24小时跌约3.3%，区间低点1717.82、高点1817.57。11月19日美国现货ETH基金合计净流出约1.312亿美元，这与“衍生品新申报立即带来持续现货买盘”不相符。当然，跌幅不能直接归咎于这份申报，ETF流量也只是一个交易日的截面。此前我讨论过企业ETH持仓和现有ETF上市规则调整；今天新增的判断是，价格事件合约改变的是表达预期的工具，不是ETH供应或基金申购机制。

我继续盯1718、1750、1780和1818。1718是近24小时低点，跌破后收不回就不谈抄底；1750收复说明短线有些承接；1780站稳并伴随基金流量改善，才算反弹更可信；1818是前高压力。若后续合约真实交易活跃、现货资金同步回流且价格站上1780，我会推翻当前观望判断；若只有衍生品热度而ETH仍跌破1718，就继续防守。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向只预设条件式现货做多。只有ETH站稳1780，回踩不破，且后续完整ETF日度流量不再明显恶化，我才用总资金2%试仓；第一目标1818，触及时减半，余下看1850。止损设在1750下方，单笔账户风险控制在0.3%以内；跌破1718、突破后重新失守1750，或实际合约数据与乐观预期不符，我取消计划或全部平仓。不用高杠杆，也不把申报当作已经成交的机构需求。

#ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

The midday update was still talking about defending 3.0, but the 17:00 hourly candle drove the low straight down to 2.994. After holding the level all day, it finally gave way. Meanwhile, BTC is once again approaching 61290—its fifth test of this level today—while ETH remains stuck below 1760.

The broader market has been range-bound between 61290 and 62600 over the past two days. Support has been tested repeatedly, while rebound highs keep moving lower. That suggests buyers are stepping in below, but selling pressure overhead is just as strong. NEAR's breakdown adds another sign of weakness: stronger coins are catching up on the downside, while weaker ones are breaking support. Investors are neither chasing longs nor willing to buy the dip, and are mostly waiting for BTC to choose a direction first.

$BTC

Currently at $61,615, down 3.51% over 24 hours.

• Support: $61,290
• Resistance: $62,069

At 16:00, BTC briefly touched 62069 before being pushed back down. The 17:00 hourly candle has already slipped to a low of 61575, with price edging toward 61290. The level has been tested four times today and held each time, but every rebound has peaked lower than the last. After repeated tests have worn down support, the significance of this fifth test is questionable. Perpetual futures funding rates are close to zero, and open interest edged down from 97,300 to 96,800 contracts in half an hour. Long accounts still make up 75.8%, but price hasn't followed suit—the market seems to be holding existing long positions and waiting, rather than chasing the move. Only a high-volume reclaim of 62069 would show that bulls have recovered. If 61290 breaks on heavy volume, there isn't much meaningful short-term support below.

$ETH

Currently at $1,746, down 3.37% over 24 hours.

• Support: $1,717.82
• Resistance: $1,759.91

ETH has been stuck in the narrow 1743–1760 range for the past two hours. At 16:00, it only managed to touch 1759.91 and couldn't even reclaim 1760; its rebound is weaker than BTC's. The funding rate is just +0.006%, and open interest is largely unchanged at 2.48 million contracts. The long-to-short account ratio slipped from 2.66 at 16:00 to 2.50, meaning the share of long accounts is declining. 1717.82 is today's low; if it doesn't hold, the next level to watch is the round-number mark at 1700. To the upside, 1759.91 is the first hurdle—ETH needs to reclaim it before we can talk about stabilization.

$NEAR

Currently at $3.00, down 12.43% over 24 hours.

• Support: $2.994
• Resistance: $3.049

NEAR is today's key breakdown to watch. It spent five hours grinding between 3.0 and 3.06, but the 17:00 hourly candle hit a low of 2.994, and the 4-hour candle also closed below 3.0. The defense of 3.0 has officially failed. Notably, open interest rose rather than fell, climbing from 54.44 million to 54.65 million contracts in half an hour. Long accounts still make up 61%, and the funding rate is near zero, so this selloff wasn't driven by funding pressure; spot selling is pushing price lower. To the upside, NEAR would need to reclaim 3.049 for this to count as a false breakdown. If it can't, there is no clear short-term support formed by the candlestick chart below 3.0; 2.9 is just a psychological round-number level.

Overall, the market remains bearish and cautious, trading sideways. BTC's 61290 level has already been tested four times, and whether it holds on the fifth test will depend on volume. After NEAR broke below 3.0, the catch-up losses in weaker coins may not be over. We need confirmation before choosing a direction: either BTC reclaims 62069 on heavy volume or breaks below 61290 on heavy volume; either NEAR reclaims 3.049 or continues sliding toward 2.9. BlackRock’s IBIT Sees $541 Million in Single-Day Outflows, Its Largest Since Launch

Amid widespread weakness in risk assets, BlackRock’s spot Bitcoin ETF saw a notable shift in funds. According to a November 20 report by Cailian Press, investors withdrew $541 million from BlackRock’s IBIT fund on Thursday, its largest single-day outflow since the fund launched in January 2024. On the same day, U.S.-listed spot Bitcoin ETFs collectively recorded net outflows of $582 million.

First, a summary of the key facts. One, IBIT saw $541 million in single-day outflows, the largest since the product’s launch. Two, spot Bitcoin ETFs across the market recorded net outflows of $582 million on the same day, meaning IBIT accounted for about 90% of the total and was by far the main driver of this round of redemptions. Three, the report noted that Bitcoin stabilized around $62,000 after falling in the previous trading session, and briefly dipped to $61,242 during Asian trading hours. Four, regarding market conditions, pessimism surrounding AI-related trades continued to weigh on markets, while hawkish signals from the Federal Reserve reinforced expectations of another rate hike in December, prompting an overall pullback in risk appetite. Paul Howard, senior director at market maker Wincent, said ETF outflows speak for themselves: a hawkish Fed is keeping pressure on risk assets, and institutional investors have yet to truly step in and buy.

Now let’s unpack the logic. IBIT is one of the world’s most closely watched spot Bitcoin ETFs, and its subscription and redemption activity is often viewed as a barometer of traditional investors’ sentiment. When expectations for macro interest rates turn tighter and sentiment toward technology and AI stocks weakens, institutions often reduce their exposure to highly volatile assets. ETF redemptions are a direct manifestation of this kind of risk reduction. Since the creation and redemption of ETF shares correspond to purchases and sales of the underlying Bitcoin, record single-day outflows can easily be interpreted as a sign of increased selling pressure in the spot market and a temporary withdrawal of institutional capital.

The potential impact on the crypto market can be broadly divided into three areas: on the capital side, net outflows directly reduce spot buying; on the sentiment side, record figures can gain widespread attention and reinforce near-term caution; structurally, if outflows continue, they could affect liquidity expectations in areas such as market making and lending. Conversely, if funds return, ETF channels can also deliver additional capital relatively quickly.

It is important to emphasize that a single day’s data should not be equated with a trend reversal. Our editorial assessment is that record outflows look more like a concentrated portfolio adjustment amid macroeconomic pressure than a rejection of the long-term investment case for Bitcoin. Going forward, three variables are worth monitoring: whether outflows persist, how well prices absorb the redemptions, and what guidance the Fed’s December policy meeting provides for interest-rate expectations. These assessments are speculative and will ultimately need to be validated by subsequent data.

content:
贝莱德IBIT单日流出5.41亿美元，创成立以来最大流出

在风险资产普遍走弱的背景下，贝莱德旗下现货比特币ETF出现了一笔标志性的资金变动。据财联社11月20日报道，投资者周四从贝莱德IBIT基金撤出5.41亿美元，创该基金2024年1月推出以来的最大单日流出规模；同日，美国上市的现货比特币ETF合计净流出5.82亿美元。

先梳理核心事实。其一，IBIT单日流出5.41亿美元，为该产品成立以来之最；其二，全市场现货比特币ETF同日净流出5.82亿美元，意味着IBIT一家贡献了约九成的流出量，是本轮赎回的绝对主力；其三，报道提及，比特币继前一交易日下跌后持稳于62000美元一线，亚洲交易时段一度下探61242美元；其四，市场环境方面，围绕AI交易的悲观情绪继续拖累市场，美联储释放的鹰派信号强化了对12月再次加息的预期，风险偏好整体收缩。做市商Wincent高级董事Paul Howard表示，ETF资金流出说明了一切，鹰派的美联储维持着风险资产面临的压力，机构投资者尚未真正出手买进。

再拆解其中的逻辑。IBIT是全球最受关注的现货比特币ETF之一，其申赎动向常被视为传统资金态度的温度计。当宏观利率预期转紧、科技与AI板块情绪回落时，机构往往降低对高波动资产的敞口，ETF赎回正是这类降风险行为的直接体现。由于ETF份额的创设与赎回对应着底层比特币的买卖，单日纪录级流出容易被解读为现货市场承接压力上升、机构资金阶段性撤离的信号。

对加密市场的影响路径大致有三层：资金面上，净流出直接减少现货买盘；情绪面上，纪录数据会被放大传播，强化短期谨慎预期；结构面上，若流出延续，可能影响做市、借贷等环节的流动性预期，反之若资金回流，ETF管道同样能较快输送增量。

需要强调的是，单日数据与趋势拐点不能画等号。编辑层面的观察是：创纪录流出更像是宏观压力下一次集中仓位调整，而非对比特币长期配置逻辑的否定；后市可重点跟踪三个变量，即流出是否连续、价格对赎回的消化程度、以及12月美联储议息对利率预期的指引。上述判断属于推测，最终仍需后续数据验证。

What exactly is MoonPay up to? Why is it suddenly seeking a U.S. trust bank charter?

MoonPay’s application for a U.S. trust bank charter primarily affects crypto custody and stablecoin operations.

MoonPay’s move is pretty sudden. It wants to obtain a U.S. national trust bank charter specifically to handle crypto custody and stablecoin issuance. Put simply, it wants to make the safekeeping and issuance of cryptocurrencies in the U.S. more like regulated banking services. Why do this? The main goal is to boost trust in the crypto industry as a whole. After all, many exchanges and projects currently custody their own coins, which carries considerable risk. By becoming a bank, MoonPay could use the banking regulatory framework and insurance mechanisms to make users feel safer. This move could affect regulation across the industry and might encourage other crypto projects to become more compliant, but it’s too early to say exactly how things will change.

Impact on the market
- Short term: The news could give sentiment around crypto prices a bit of a boost. Compliance is generally a good thing and can attract more traditional capital. Investors may pay more attention to projects that move quickly on compliance.
- Medium term: The industry landscape could change. In the future, crypto custody and stablecoin providers may all have to take the banking route. Regulatory trends could also become clearer, and other countries may follow suit with similar licensing systems.

My take
I think this move is positive for the industry as a whole, but the market reaction may not be particularly dramatic in the short term. The key is how U.S. regulators handle the application. If it goes through, it could be a long-term positive. Don’t come down too hard on me if I’m wrong—I’m only trying it with a small position myself. title: $ETH价格方向与成交参与度不一致，从知识点到机会图
subTitle:
$ETH 的24小时涨跌已经发生，真正难的是别让过去替下一段行情作答。眼下我只追一个问题：$ETH价格方向与成交参与度不一致。方向暂时存在，但低参与度让这段走势的可信度打了折扣。

$ETH现在是1,746.01，24小时-3.30%，这段时间走过1,717.82—1,817.57。距离1小时支撑1,717.82约1.61%，距离压力1,817.57约4.10%。1小时偏弱，4小时偏弱，量能是近20根均量的0.57倍。

title: 资金费率是什么？为什么多头要给空头掏钱
subTitle:
玩永续合约绕不开一个词：资金费率。它每8小时结算一次，是多空之间
互相支付的一笔钱，交易所只是代收代付，不赚这个钱。

【机制】永续合约没有交割日，价格怎么和现货保持一致？就靠资金费率：
合约价高于现货价（多头情绪旺）→ 费率为正 → 多头付钱给空头；
合约价低于现货价（空头占优）→ 费率为负 → 空头付钱给多头。
钱在两边倒腾，把合约价格往现货价格上拽。

【代价】别小看这每8小时一笔：年化下来费率高的时候能到百分之几十。
做多时如果一直付高费率，就算方向看对了，利润也会被悄悄磨掉。

【一条实用习惯】开仓前看一眼当前费率。高正费率时追多，你在给空头
打工；极端负费率时追空，同理。费率不是方向指标，但它是成本，成本
影响你这笔交易的性价比。

translatedData.title: What Is the Funding Rate? Why Do Longs Have to Pay Shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
There’s one term you can’t avoid when trading perpetual contracts: the funding rate. It’s settled every 8 hours and is a payment between longs and shorts
that they pay to each other. The exchange only collects and distributes it; it doesn’t make money from it.

【How it works】Perpetual contracts have no expiry date, so how does their price stay in line with the spot price? That’s where the funding rate comes in:
When the contract price is above the spot price (strong bullish sentiment) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is below the spot price (bears have the upper hand) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
The money flows back and forth, pulling the contract price toward the spot price.

title: 从保证金提醒到强平，中间发生了什么
subTitle:
强平不是一瞬间的事，它是一个流程。看懂这个流程，你就知道该在哪儿行动。

【第一步】初始保证金：开仓时占用的钱，比如10倍杠杆就是仓位的10%。
【第二步】行情反向走，保证金率上升。App开始弹「保证金不足」提醒，
这时候你还有选择：减仓降杠杆，或者补保证金。
【第三步】维持保证金线：亏损吃穿维持保证金要求，系统开始部分强平，
先平一部分回收风险，而不是一把全平。
【第四步】如果继续恶化，全部强平，你这笔仓位宣告结束。

【重点】从第二步的提醒到第三步的强平，中间是你最后的自救窗口。
但绝大多数人在这个时刻做的不是减仓，而是「再等等」「补点仓摊薄」——
把一个可控的小错误，拖成毁灭性的大错误。记住：提醒弹出来的时候，
正确的动作是减仓，不是加仓。

translatedData.title: What happens between a margin alert and liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation doesn’t happen in an instant—it’s a process. Understand how it works, and you’ll know when to act.

[Step 1] Initial margin: The funds tied up when you open a position. For example, with 10x leverage, it’s 10% of the position size.
[Step 2] The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts showing “Insufficient margin” alerts,
At this point, you still have options: reduce your position to lower leverage, or add margin.
[Step 3] Maintenance margin level: Once losses eat through the maintenance margin requirement, the system begins partially liquidating your position,
closing part of it first to reduce risk, rather than closing it all at once.

The ETH that was stolen from Binance is being split up again, but don’t rush to shout “dump.” I just checked the on-chain transfers over the last two days, and there’s one detail nobody has mentioned.

Today from 16:12 to 16:28 (Beijing time), Exploiter 8 address 0x8532…43D4 sent exactly 12,000 ETH each to 16 new addresses, and the remaining 5,459.99 ETH was transferred to 0x0C62…44Fa. The original address now holds only 0.018 ETH.

The key is yesterday. From 11/19 14:51 to 15:07, another related address, 0xc887…286a, used the exact same method to split 137,602 ETH: 11 transfers of 12,000 ETH, and a final 5,601.98 ETH. The same 0x0C62…44Fa received the remainder. Same final address, same amount, same roughly 16-minute span — basically the same script.

Look at the result: as of now, the 11 wallets from yesterday still each hold exactly 12,000 ETH, and none of them has moved a single coin. 0x0C62 is holding 11,061.97 ETH, and there are no outbound transfers on-chain.

Here’s my own tally: 27 wallets × 12,000 = 324,000 ETH, plus the remainder address, for a total of about 335,000 ETH in a "split and waiting" state. At today’s price of around $1,750, that’s close to $590 million.

So this is not selling; it’s positioning. Splitting into fixed denominations is usually preparation for the next step, possibly a cross-chain bridge, a mixer, or OTC. Nobody knows which path it will take yet, so anyone saying it will "dump immediately" is just guessing. What’s really worth watching is the first move from those 27 wallets, and whether the funds go to exchange deposit addresses or to a bridge contract. The former is still just a deposit, not necessarily a trade.

Before that happens, using this as a reason to short ETH is basically just working for your emotions.

#ETH #Binance

Each fungible token is identical, such as one ETH being no different from another ETH; NFTs, however, are all different.
If the metadata and images are stored on centralized servers, the tokens will still exist after the servers shut down, but their content may no longer be viewable.
Transferring and buying or selling NFTs on Ethereum all require paying Gas with $ETH .

以太坊上的 NFT 转移和买卖都得用 $ETH 支付 Gas。

A protocol changed its contract logic overnight. Are the assets users deposited still safe?
First, the definition: during an upgrade, an account with upgrade privileges changes the proxy contract to point to a new logic contract. The address users interact with stays the same, but the logic being executed changes.
Why do this? Upgradability lets projects fix vulnerabilities and launch new features. The trade-off is that users have to trust whoever holds upgrade privileges not to make arbitrary changes or lose their private keys.
Back to the market: $ETH  is currently at 1756.09, down 2.61% over 24 hours.

Market Snapshot | CYBER Explodes in One Hour, BTC Holds 61290

The biggest thing to watch in today’s market was CYBER suddenly surging nearly 50% in one hour. Meanwhile, BTC held around 61290 before rebounding to near 62000, with large- and small-cap markets moving to completely different rhythms.

The broader market has been grinding within the 61290–62600 range for the past two days. It has tested the lows several times without breaking through, but each rebound has peaked lower than the last. This suggests there are buyers below, but selling pressure above is also substantial. Sudden high-volume rallies in tokens like CYBER are usually a sign that traders are looking for volatile assets to trade in the short term amid a weak market. Whether the move lasts depends on whether trading volume can keep up—you can’t judge by the percentage gain alone.

$BTC

Currently at 61984 USD, down 2.69% over 24 hours.

• Support: 61290 USD
• Resistance: 62069 USD

At 15:00, it dipped to a low of 61468 and recovered. At 16:00, it continued pushing up toward 62069. The 61290 level has been tested several times today, and short-term bulls are still holding the line. However, rebound highs have steadily declined from 62639 to 62069, and volume is also low. Unless BTC can reclaim 62285, it will remain range-bound. If it breaks below 61290 on strong volume, there isn’t much meaningful support below. Futures funding rates are essentially at zero, and open interest has barely changed in six hours. The long/short account ratio is 3.35: long accounts are in the majority, but the price hasn’t followed, suggesting traders are mostly sitting on the sidelines rather than chasing longs.

$ETH

Currently at 1756 USD, down 2.68% over 24 hours.

• Support: 1717.82 USD
• Resistance: 1760 USD

ETH has been moving sideways around 1750 for the past two hours. It hit a low of 1739 at 15:00 and a high of 1759.91 at 16:00. The low of 1717.82 hasn’t been retested, but ETH hasn’t broken above 1760 either. The long/short account ratio slipped from 3.07 to 2.66, as long accounts declined. Open interest edged up to 2.49 million coins, while the funding rate is just +0.0056%. Overall, it’s weak and range-bound, waiting for BTC to provide direction.

$CYBER

Currently at 0.30 USD, up 47.06% over 24 hours.

• Support: 0.222 USD
• Resistance: 0.308 USD

CYBER is today’s standout mover. It traded flat around 0.20–0.21 for most of the day, then volume suddenly surged to 1.62 million coins at 15:00 and straight to 14.24 million at 16:00—70 times the previous hourly volume. The price shot from 0.222 to 0.308, putting it right near its 24-hour high. The futures funding rate is -1.21%, short accounts are in the majority (long/short account ratio: 0.59), and open interest rose from 14.5 million to 15.1 million coins. With price, volume, and negative funding all lining up, this has the makings of a strong short squeeze. But chasing a move this steep is risky: if it can’t hold 0.308, gains could quickly be given back. 0.222 was the launch point for this move; a break below it would suggest the rally has run its course for now.

My take:

The broader market is still fundamentally range-bound. BTC has held 61290, but selling pressure above 62069 is substantial. We’ll need to see a high-volume breakout in either direction before confirming the trend. CYBER is a short-term move driven by traders seeking volatility. Volume and negative funding support another push higher, but it’s already at an elevated level, so consider what you’ll do if it breaks below 0.222 before chasing. My approach: leave my broader-market positions unchanged and wait for direction; watch the volatile tokens without trading them, at least until a pullback confirms the move.

市场盘面｜CYBER 一小时爆拉、BTC 守住 61290

今天盘面最值得关注的是 CYBER 在一小时内突然爆拉近 50%，而大盘这边 BTC 守住 61290 一线后反抽回 62000 附近，大小盘面走出了完全不同的节奏。

大盘这两天一直在 61290—62600 这个区间里磨，几次探底都没破，但每次反弹的高点也在往下移，说明下方有人接、但上方抛压同样不轻。CYBER 这种冷不丁的放量拉升，通常是资金在弱势里找弹性标的做短线，持续性要看成交量能不能续上，不能只看涨幅。

$BTC

现报 61984 美元，24 小时下跌 2.69%。

• 支撑：61290 美元
• 压力：62069 美元

15 点最低踩到 61468 就收回，16 点继续往 62069 上顶，61290 今天已多次被验证，短期多头还守得住。不过反弹高点一路从 62639 下移到 62069，量能也不大，站不回 62285 还是区间震荡；放量跌破 61290 的话，下方就没什么像样的支撑了。合约资金费率基本归零、持仓量 6 小时没动，多空账户比 3.35，多头账户占优但价格没跟上，场内更多是观望而不是追多。

$ETH

现报 1756 美元，24 小时下跌 2.68%。

• 支撑：1717.82 美元
• 压力：1760 美元

ETH 这两小时贴着 1750 横着，15 点最低 1739、16 点最高 1759.91，1717.82 的低点没再被碰，但 1760 也没站上去。多空账户比从 3.07 滑到 2.66，多头账户在减少，持仓量小幅抬到 249 万枚，资金费率只有 +0.0056%，整体就是弱势横盘、等 BTC 给方向。

$CYBER

现报 0.30 美元，24 小时上涨 47.06%。

• 支撑：0.222 美元
• 压力：0.308 美元

CYBER 是今天最扎眼的异动：全天横在 0.20—0.21 没动，15 点突然放量到 162 万枚、16 点直接干到 1424 万枚，是之前一小时量能的七十倍，价格一口气从 0.222 拉到 0.308，24 小时高点就在眼前。合约资金费率 -1.21%，空头账户占优（多空账户比 0.59），持仓量从 1450 万枚抬到 1510 万枚，价格、量能、负费率凑在一起，逼空味很重。但这种斜率追高风险也大，0.308 站不稳容易回吐，0.222 是这波启动点，跌破就说明行情先告一段落。

我的观察：

大盘还是区间震荡的底子，61290 守住了但 62069 上方抛压不轻，方向要等放量突破一边再确认。CYBER 属于资金找弹性的短线行情，量能和负费率都支持它再冲一冲，但位置已经很高，追高前先想好 0.222 跌破了怎么办。我的态度是：大盘仓位不动、等方向，异动币只看不动手，至少等回踩确认再说。

你觉得 CYBER 这波是逼空行情的开始，还是拉高出货的一日游？

美国富达投资悄悄把价值43.5亿美元的比特币转入新钱包，这个动作被链上监控服务Onchain Lens发现。这批BTC从富达信托的保管账户流出，分散到了至少5个新创建的钱包。这发生在机构比特币持续流入传统金融的背景下，引发市场猜测：富达这是在避税，还是为更大规模的抛售做准备？

富达作为美国最大比特币保管机构，其资金动向极具信号意义。这次大规模转仓可能发生在两个极端：要么是合规需求，比如美国税收政策要求机构披露大额持仓；要么是富达在为即将到来的比特币ETF申请做铺垫，通过分散持仓避免ETF备案时暴露过大的单一大额持仓。从操作手法看，将大量BTC拆分到多个新钱包，更像是为了掩盖资金来源，符合避税操作特征。

操作思路
目前看，富达的操作更像是合规调整，而非大规模抛售信号。这意味着短期内比特币价格不必过度恐慌。但如果后续出现更多机构出现类似操作，并伴随ETF申请失败传闻，可能会形成短期利空。如果富达这些新钱包的BTC后来出现在二级市场交易，反而可能提供阶段性买点。

ETH ETF Rule Change | Existing Products Continue Trading | I’m Waiting for Funds and Price to Align

My stance is to watch cautiously and not interpret the exchange rule adjustment as a new wave of institutional buying for ETH. Documents released by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on November 16 show that Cboe BZX submitted an immediately effective rule change on November 9, covering the already-listed Invesco Galaxy Ethereum ETF and Bitcoin ETF. The core of the filing is to allow these two existing products to continue trading under the generic listing standards for commodity-based trust shares. The products had already been approved; this is not approval of new ETFs, does not announce new inflows, and does not change the supply or fee rules of the Ethereum network itself.

This is worth watching, but it’s important to keep it in perspective. For investors, generic standards may make the ongoing listing requirements for these products more consistent and reduce the friction involved in interpreting rules for each product individually in the future. For ETH spot prices, at most, this first changes how easily institutions can access the products under the regulatory framework. For it to create genuine spot demand, we would still need to see actual changes in fund net subscriptions, market making, and the custody chain. There is an investment decision between a rule filing and net subscriptions; the words “immediately effective” cannot tell us how much ETH will be bought today. The SEC filing also states that both funds must continue to meet ongoing listing requirements; it is not a pass that allows them to ignore risk.

The market reaction has not provided strong confirmation. At the time of writing, ETH/USDT on Binance was around 1,756, still down about 2.5% over the past 24 hours, with a low of around 1,718 and a high of around 1,818. This only shows that prices are still fluctuating; it does not prove that the decline was caused by this rule filing. U.S. spot ETH funds also saw combined net outflows of about $131.2 million last night, which is inconsistent with the claim that “regulatory convenience has already translated into incremental buying.” I’ve discussed recent corporate holdings and staking figures separately, so I won’t repackage existing holdings as a new positive catalyst today.

The levels I’m watching are 1,718, 1,750, 1,780, and 1,818. Whether ETH can hold around 1,750 will determine whether a short-term rebound has basic support. A sustained move above 1,780 accompanied by improving fund flows would be the first sign that demand is being confirmed. 1,818 is the recent high of the range above. If ETH breaks below 1,718 again and fails to recover, my view that it’s worth waiting for a rebound is invalidated. Likewise, if the price spikes on the rule-change headline but quickly falls back below 1,750, I wouldn’t chase it.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now. I’m only considering a small, conditional spot long, with no high leverage. I would consider testing the waters with 2% of my total capital only if ETH regains and holds above 1,780, successfully retests that level, and subsequent fund data shows that significant net outflows have stopped. My first target would be 1,818, where I’d close half the position; I’d let the rest run toward 1,850, but wouldn’t assume it will get there. I’d place a stop-loss below 1,750 and limit the risk on any single trade to 0.3% of my account. If fund flows continue to deteriorate, the price falls below 1,718, or ETH breaks out and then falls back below 1,750, I’d cancel the plan or close the entire position. If the conditions don’t appear, I’ll stay on the sidelines—waiting is not the same as making a trade.

ETH基金规则切换｜旧产品继续交易｜我只等资金与价格共振

我的态度是谨慎观察，暂不把交易所规则调整解读成ETH获得一笔新的机构买盘。美国证监会11月16日发布的文件显示，Cboe BZX在11月9日提交了即时生效的规则变更，涉及已经上市交易的Invesco Galaxy以太坊ETF及比特币ETF。文件的核心，是让这两只现有产品转到商品类信托份额的通用上市标准之下继续交易。原有产品此前已经获批；这次不是新ETF获批，也没有宣布新资金流入，更没有改变以太坊网络本身的供给或手续费规则。

这件事值得看，但要放对位置。对投资人而言，通用标准可能使产品的持续上市条件更统一，减少未来逐只产品解释规则的摩擦；对ETH现货价格而言，它最多先改变机构接触产品的制度便利度。真正形成现货需求，还得看到基金净申购、做市和托管链条的实际变化。规则文件与净申购之间隔着投资决策，不能用“即时生效”四个字推算今天会有多少ETH被买入。SEC文件也写明，这两只基金仍须满足持续上市要求，并非获得一张可以忽略风险的通行证。

市场反应并未给出强势确认。写稿时币安ETH/USDT约1756，过去24小时仍跌约2.5%，区间低点约1718、高点约1818。这只能说明价格仍在波动，不能证明跌幅由这份规则文件造成。昨晚美国现货ETH基金合计净流出约1.312亿美元，也与“制度便利已经转化成增量买盘”的说法不一致。近期公司持仓和质押数字我已单独讨论过，本轮不把存量持仓重复包装成今天的新利好。

我的观察位是1718、1750、1780和1818。1750附近能否守住，决定短线反弹有没有基本承接；1780以上站稳并伴随基金流量改善，才算需求开始验证；1818是上方近期区间高点。若再跌破1718并持续收不回，等待反弹的判断就被推翻；若只因规则标题冲高却很快跌回1750，同样不能追。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向仅准备条件式小仓位现货做多，不做高杠杆。只有ETH重新站稳1780，回踩不破，并看到后续基金数据停止明显净流出，我才考虑用总资金的2%试仓；第一目标1818，触及时减去一半，剩余仓位看1850但不预设必到。止损放在1750下方，且单笔账户风险控制在0.3%以内；若基金流量继续恶化、价格跌破1718，或突破后重新跌回1750，我会取消计划或全部平仓。条件未出现就是空仓等待，绝不把等待写成成交。

title: 逐仓和全仓有什么区别？新手该用哪个？
subTitle:
开合约时会让你选「逐仓」或「全仓」，很多新手随手一点，结果吃了大亏。

【全仓】账户里所有余额都作为保证金。优点：强平价远，不容易被打爆；
缺点：一旦行情极端，亏损可能吃掉你整个账户。它是把所有鸡蛋放在一个
篮子里互相撑着。

【逐仓】只把指定的一笔钱分配给这个仓位。这个仓爆了，最多亏这一份，
不会传染到其他仓位和本金。风险被装进了笼子里。

【我的建议】新手一律逐仓。原因很简单：你还没有能力评估「一笔错单最坏
亏多少」，那就用制度帮你锁定最大损失。等你学会了仓位管理、连续三
个月稳定盈利，再考虑全仓也来得及。市场里活得久，比赚得快重要一百倍。

translatedData.title: What's the difference between isolated and cross margin? Which should beginners use?
translatedData.subTitle:
When opening a futures position, you'll be asked to choose “isolated” or “cross” margin. Many beginners just tap one without thinking and end up taking a big loss.

【Cross margin】Your entire account balance is used as margin. Advantage: the liquidation price is far away, so you're less likely to get liquidated;
Disadvantage: if the market moves extremely, your losses could wipe out your entire account. It's like putting all your eggs in one
They all support one another in the same basket.

【Isolated margin】Only a specified amount of money is allocated to this position. If it gets liquidated, you can lose at most that amount,
and the loss won't spread to your other positions or your principal. The risk is kept in a cage.

【My advice】Beginners should always use isolated margin. The reason is simple: you aren't yet able to assess the worst-case scenario for “one bad trade

First, a definition: CryptoKitties, launched at the end of 2017, once caused severe congestion on Ethereum and was one of the early NFT projects to break into the mainstream.
The underlying logic: NFT prices are determined by transactions between buyers and sellers. Trading activity is often lower than for fungible tokens, so when you want to sell, you may not be able to find a buyer.
Transferring and trading NFTs on Ethereum requires paying Gas $ETH .
There’s no shame in taking it slow. Staying in the game matters more than how much you make in a single trade.

Market Snapshot | BTC tests 61,290 for the fourth time; rebounds are getting weaker

The most noteworthy thing in today's market wasn't how much prices fell, but that each rebound was weaker than the last when BTC returned to around 61,290 for the fourth time.

The broader market spent the day hovering near its lows. BTC tested 61,290 twice in the morning and bounced both times, but the 10:00 rebound still managed to reach 62,284, while by 14:00 it only got to 62,066. The 15:00 candle opened at 62,056 and fell as low as 61,467. The level held, but momentum faded. ETH weakened in tandem, with its 24-hour loss already exceeding BTC's. Among altcoins, YB tried three times to break above 0.0595 but failed to hold there, then dropped straight back to around 0.0528 at 15:00, suggesting that short-term buyers who chased the rally are starting to bail. The most concerning combination is “support still holding, but buying pressure thinning”: if a high-volume bearish candle takes out 61,290, there is no obvious buffer below.

$BTC

Currently trading at $61,626, down 3.15% over 24 hours.

• Support: $61,290
• Resistance: $62,066

The 61,290 level was tested four times today: 61,295 at 09:00, 61,290.58 at 10:00, 61,389 at 12:00, and 61,467 at 15:00. Yet rebound highs kept moving lower. Open interest in the futures market has barely changed over the past 5 hours, holding around 97,000 BTC. The funding rate is just +0.0007%, and 77% of accounts are long—longs haven't exited, but no one is adding to their positions either, leaving the market at an impasse. Only a move back above 62,066 would suggest this round of bottom-testing has stabilized for now. If 61,290 breaks, watch for support near the 60,000 round-number level. It's not yet time to chase a rebound.

$ETH

Currently trading at $1,743, down 3.35% over 24 hours.

• Support: $1,717.82
• Resistance: $1,750.89

ETH was weaker than BTC today, with its 24-hour loss already exceeding that of the broader market. The 12:00 candle set a new 24-hour low at 1,717.82. The rebound at 14:00 stalled at 1,750.89, and the 15:00 low fell to 1,739.17. Open interest is around 2.49 million ETH, with little change over the past 5 hours. The funding rate is +0.0044%, and 72.9% of accounts are long. Structurally, ETH is in the same position as BTC: “no one is exiting, but no one is chasing longs either.” A move back above 1,750.89 would reopen the door to further gains. A break below 1,717.82 would raise the risk of an accelerated catch-up decline. Until its relative weakness against BTC reverses, ETH isn't an attractive standalone long.

$YB

Currently trading at $0.0528, up 14.29% over 24 hours.

• Support: $0.0503
• Resistance: $0.0595

Today's story for YB was “three failed attempts to break 0.0595.” It reached 0.059 at 11:00, then made another run at 0.0595 at 14:00 on volume of 11.65 million tokens. If 0.0503 holds, another attempt is possible; if it breaks, price may need to consolidate again around 0.047.

What I'm watching:

The current bias is bearish, but I wouldn't chase shorts. BTC's fourth test of 61,290, with each rebound high moving lower, is today's clearest sign of weakness. The dividing line is 61,290: if it holds, a period of consolidation and recovery is still possible; if the daily close falls below it, the broader market is likely to test 60,000. For now, reduce leverage and keep cash on hand until the direction is confirmed. ETH is weaker than BTC, so buying the dip in ETH alone doesn't offer much value. YB's funding rate is deeply negative and open interest is still rising, so short-term volatility could be significant. It is only suitable for a small position, watching the 0.0503 and 0.0595 levels; don't chase in between.

An attacker suspected of stealing 52,000 XMR1 sold all the tokens on Hyperliquid and used the proceeds of 132,200 USDC to buy 7,467 ETH.

- Medium term: The incident highlights the risks posed by privacy coins on liquidity protocols and may prompt DeFi projects to strengthen on-chain tracking and cooperation with regulators. Confidence in the broader cryptocurrency industry may come under pressure in the short term.

Overall, this incident is neutral to slightly bearish for the market. It mainly exposes a security vulnerability rather than directly triggering a shift in market sentiment. ETH is currently near the key support level of $1.7K. If more similar attacks occur, investors may become concerned about privacy coins and DeFi security. 【If ZEC gets an ETF, does that mean institutions are coming?】

A lot of people get excited as soon as they hear “ETF”: isn’t this hooking ZEC up to the institutional money pipeline? The counterintuitive part is that an ETF solves “how to buy,” but doesn’t guarantee “someone will buy.” Bitwise is seeking to list a Zcash ETF on the Texas Stock Exchange, with Coinbase Custody proposed as custodian and Bitwise Investment Advisers as manager and sponsor. Note: this is an application, not an approval—let alone money flowing in.

In practice, it opens a compliant entry point for traditional capital, directly benefiting custody, trading, and liquidity. ZEC may have another channel, but a channel isn’t the same as demand. We should even be wary of people treating the ETF as an exit tool, making it easier to sell.

The business logic only works halfway. ZEC’s calling card is privacy; the ETF’s is standardization and compliance. It’s like putting a gourmet dish in a standard lunchbox: it can be served, but the market still has to like the taste. The fear index is only at 12. At a time like this, shouting “institutions are coming” can easily turn into a chant to provide exit liquidity. I saw this playbook back in 2017; the way they fleece people hasn’t changed.

Remember: an ETF application is a story about access; actual holdings and net inflows are what look like demand. Don’t mistake “you can buy” for “people will buy.” I’m tempted to jump in too, but this time I’ll wait to see it actually happen and won’t draw conclusions for anyone else.

What worries you more: that no one will buy, or that buyers will show up only for the ETF to become a tool for unloading? Feeling tempted to jump in?

#ZEC #加密市场 #ETH #MarketSense

【ZEC要有ETF，就等于机构要来了？】

很多人一听ETF就兴奋：这不是给ZEC接上机构水管？反常识的是，ETF解决“怎么买”，不保证“有人买”。Bitwise正寻求让Zcash ETF在得州证券交易所上市，Coinbase Custody拟托管ZEC，Bitwise Investment Advisers任管理人和发起人。注意，是申请，不是获批，更不是资金进场。

落到实处，它给传统资金开了一条合规入口，托管、交易和流动性环节直接受益；ZEC虽然多了渠道，但渠道不等于需求。甚至要防有人把ETF当退出工具，卖出反而方便。

商业逻辑只算半通。ZEC的招牌是隐私，ETF的招牌是标准化和合规，像把硬菜装进标准餐盒：能端上桌，味道还得市场买账。恐惧指数只有12，此时喊“机构要来了”，最容易变成接盘口号。这套路我2017年就见过，割法没换。

记住：ETF申请是渠道故事，实际持仓和净流入才像需求。别把“能买”误当“会买”。手痒是真，我这次只看落地，不替人下结论。

这波你们怕没人买，还是怕买盘来了却成了出货工具？手痒不痒？

📰 Why are miners silent en masse? Asian stock market crash sends BTC to new lows

Asian stock markets plunged suddenly on Friday, sending Bitcoin below the $62,000 mark to a low of $61,300, its lowest level since early July. South Korean exchanges suspended program trading amid the sell-off, signaling that market panic has spread from the US and Europe to Asia, one of the world’s most active cryptocurrency markets. For crypto, this means Asian investors’ confidence is eroding rapidly.

Why does this news matter?
The key transmission path behind this decline is worth noting: Anthropic’s IPO on Thursday, US time, underperformed expectations, triggering a global stock sell-off. The downturn then spread to crypto markets after major Asian indices, such as the Nikkei 225 and Hang Seng Index, plunged. South Korea is one of the world’s most active crypto trading markets, and the withdrawal of local funds directly intensified selling pressure on BTC. This suggests that risk appetite is deteriorating systemically across the market, rather than this being just a negative event confined to the US.

Market impact
For BTC, $61,300 is not only a technical support level but also a psychological threshold. Selling in Asian markets suggests that capital holding crypto worldwide may be rotating. Some dollar-denominated funds that have left US tech stocks may be seeking safe-haven assets, but weak market sentiment is making it difficult for Bitcoin to escape the downturn. Historical data shows that sentiment in Asian markets often foreshadows short-term volatility cycles globally.

Trading outlook
BTC is currently in a clearly weak consolidation pattern, with the $61,000–$61,500 range serving as a key support zone. If Asian stocks continue to fall, or outflows from South Korea and other markets persist, this support level could be breached further. This means that if there is more negative news on fund flows, Bitcoin could continue to fall toward the $60,000 area. This view would no longer apply if there are signs of a significant recovery in global risk appetite.

title: 杠杆到底是啥？100U怎么撬动1000U，代价是什么
subTitle:
很多刚进场的朋友问我：10倍杠杆是不是就是赚10倍？今天用大白话讲清楚。

【本质】杠杆是交易所借钱给你开仓。你有100U本金，开10倍杠杆，实际控
制的是1000U的仓位。币价涨1%，你的本金赚10%（相对本金）；反过来，
跌1%，本金亏10%——注意，亏损是按你借来的总仓位算的。

【代价】10倍杠杆下，币价反向走约10%，你的本金就归零，这叫爆仓。不是
跌10%才亏完，是跌约10%就全部没了（准确点位还和保证金率有关）。
杠杆放大的不是你的胜率，是波动。方向对，它加速你赚钱；方向错，它加速
你出局。工具没好坏，取决于你有没有把它当工具，而不是当赌具。

【新手建议】先用2-3倍感受波动，把止损练成肌肉记忆，再谈放大。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: What exactly is leverage? How can 100U control 1,000U, and what’s the cost?
translatedData.subTitle:
A lot of people who are new to trading ask me: Does 10x leverage mean you make 10 times as much? Today, I’ll explain it in plain English.

【The basics】Leverage means the exchange lends you money to open a position. If you have 100U of your own capital and use 10x leverage, you actually control
a position worth 1,000U. If the coin price rises by 1%, you make 10% on your capital; conversely,
A 1% drop means a 10% loss of your capital—note that the loss is calculated based on the total borrowed position.

【The cost】With 10x leverage, if the coin price moves against you by about 10%, your capital is wiped out. This is called liquidation. It’s not that
you only lose everything after a 10% drop; at around 10%, it’s all gone (the exact price also depends on the margin ratio).

title: 交易干货 | 满仓一把梭的数学期望，看完你还敢吗
subTitle:
假设一个策略胜率60%，对了赚50%，错了亏50%。听上去不错吧？
如果每次满仓，算一下长期结果：60%×50% - 40%×50% = 每笔期望+10%，
看着是正期望。但注意路径：连错两次就是-75%，需要+300%才能回本。
正期望的策略+满仓执行=大概率破产，这就是赌徒破产定理在币圈的
日常上演。

同样的策略，改成每次只动20%仓位：连错两次-18%，毫无杀伤力，
长期期望照吃。策略没变，变的只是仓位，生死就不同。

记住这个不等式：你的长期收益 ≈ 策略期望 × 你能活多久。仓位决定
后者。活得久的人，才有资格谈期望值。

translatedData.title: Trading Insights | The Math Behind Going All-In—Would You Still Dare After Reading This?
translatedData.subTitle:
Suppose a strategy has a 60% win rate, earning 50% on a win and losing 50% on a loss. Sounds pretty good, right?
If you go all-in every time, here’s the long-term expected return: 60% × 50% - 40% × 50% = an expected gain of 10% per trade,
That looks like a positive expected return. But consider the path: two losses in a row mean -75%, and you’d need a +300% gain just to break even.
A positive-expectation strategy + going all-in = a high probability of ruin. That’s the gambler’s ruin theorem
playing out every day in crypto.

With the same strategy, but risking only 20% of your position each time: two losses in a row = -18%, barely a dent,
while you still capture the long-term expected returns. The strategy hasn’t changed; only your position size has—and that makes all the difference between survival and ruin.

title: علاش غياب حدّ أقصى لعدد ETH يقلقني كمشتري في السوق الفوري؟
subTitle:
أنا كي نشري $ETH  في السوق الفوري، نشري العملة ونحتفظ بها أو نبيعها. ما رانيش نشارك في تأمين الشبكة، وما رانيش نحكي على العقود الآجلة. أنا مجرد مالك للعملة، وامتلاكها وحده ما يعطينيش حق نقرّر كيفاش تخدم الشبكة، ولا شحال تصدر من عملات.
لهذا، من الأمور اللي تقلقني في إيثيريوم هي أن ETH ما عندهاش حدّ أقصى ثابت للعدد الإجمالي.
واش معناها؟ معناها ما كاش رقم نهائي تقول عنده الشبكة: «وصلنا لهذا العدد، ومن هنا ما نزيدوش نصدروا ETH جديدة».
هذا ماشي معناه يطبعوا كمية هائلة دفعة واحدة، ولا أن مؤسّس إيثيريوم يقدر يصدر كما يحب. الإصدار يخدم حسب قواعد الشبكة، وتتصدر ETH جديدة كمكافآت للمدقّقين اللي يساهموا في تأمينها. بصح بالنسبة ليا كمشتري في الفوري، النتيجة تبقى: العدد قابل للزيادة، وما كاش سقف نهائي ثابت نقدر نبني عليه حساب الندرة.
### أنا نملك العملة، بصح ما نتحكّمش في قواعدها
كي نشري ETH، ما نشريش سهمًا في مؤسسة، وما نولّيش صاحب قرار في الشبكة لمجرد أن عندي العملة.
إذا تبدّلت قواعد الإصدار عبر ترقية تتبنّاها الشبكة، أنا كمشتري عادي ما عنديش حق فردي نوقف هذا التغيير. نقدر نقبل ونبقى مالك للعملة، أو نرفض ونبيع، بصح ما نقدرش نفرض عليهم القواعد اللي تناسب استثماري.
وهنا بالضبط يجي قلقي: نحط مالي في أصل، بصح بعض الظروف اللي تأثّر على معروضه ماشي تحت تحكّمي.
### والحرق، هل يحلّ هذا القلق؟
إيثيريوم يحرق جزءًا من رسوم استعمال الشبكة، يعني ينحّي ETH نهائيًا من المعروض. وفي الجهة الأخرى، كاين إصدار جديد يزيد المعروض.
إذا الإصدار أكثر من الحرق، العدد يزيد. وإذا الحرق أكثر من الإصدار، العدد ينقص. وإذا تساووا خلال فترة معيّنة، العدد يبقى تقريبًا ثابتًا خلال هذي الفترة.
بصح التوازن في فترة ماشي ضمان للتوازن للأبد. مقدار الحرق يتغيّر، والإصدار عنده حساباته، وما كاش ضمان أنهم يبقاو متساويين.
وزيد، أنا كمشتري في الفوري ما توصلنيش مكافآت الإصدار تلقائيًا، والحرق ما يزيدليش عدد ETH اللي في حسابي. صحيح يقدر يفيدني بشكل غير مباشر إذا أثّر على المعروض ودعم السعر، بصح هذي استفادة محتملة، ماشي دخل مباشر ولا ربح مضمون.
### علاش نفرّق بين بيع الناس وإصدار عملات جديدة؟
إذا واحد يبيع ETH اللي عنده، العملات تنتقل من شخص لشخص. العدد الإجمالي ما يزيدش بسبب البيع وحده.
أما الإصدار، فيضيف وحدات جديدة ما كانتش موجودة من قبل. وإذا عندي 1 ETH، تبقى عندي 1 ETH، بصح إذا زاد العدد الإجمالي، حصّتي من هذا العدد تصغر.
هذا ما يعنيش أن السعر يهبط تلقائيًا، لأن الطلب والحرق يأثّروا أيضًا. بصح أنا نشوفه خطرًا مختلفًا عن مجرد بيع الناس لعملاتهم: هنا ما يتغيّرش المالك فقط، بل يقدر يتغيّر المعروض نفسه.
### موقفي ماشي أن إيثيريوم لازم يفشل
أنا ما نقولش إن غياب الحدّ الأقصى يعني انهيار السعر، ولا أن الشبكة ما عندهاش فائدة. وما نقولش إن العملة اللي عندها سقف ثابت مضمونة؛ حتى هي تقدر تخسر قيمتها إذا نقص الطلب.
أنا نقول فقط إن غياب السقف النهائي ما يناسبش بالضرورة طريقة تفكيري كمشتري في الفوري.
نقدر نفهم علاش الشبكة تصدر مكافآت، ونفهم دور الحرق، وفي نفس الوقت نبقى قلقان من معروض قابل للزيادة، وأنا ما عنديش قرار فيه.
في الأخير، السؤال بالنسبة ليا ماشي غير: «إيثيريوم واش يقدر يدير؟» السؤال أيضًا هو: «أنا واش نملك بالضبط، وواش من مخاطر نقبل كي نحط مالي فيه؟»
نقدر نحترم التكنولوجيا تاع إيثيريوم، بصح هذا ما يلزمنيش نكون مرتاح لامتلاك ETH. غياب حدّ أقصى ثابت يبقى عامل خطر نحسب له، حتى إذا ما سبّبش هبوط السعر اليوم.

translatedData.title: Why does the lack of a maximum supply of ETH worry me as a spot market buyer?
translatedData.subTitle:
When I buy $ETH  on the spot market, I buy the coin and hold it or sell it. I’m not participating in securing the network, and I’m not talking about futures. I’m simply a coin holder, and owning it alone doesn’t give me the right to decide how the network works or how many coins it issues.
Therefore, one thing that concerns me about Ethereum is that ETH has no fixed maximum total supply.

After losing money, the easiest thing to do is invest more to bring down your average cost.

I’ve done it. The reasoning sounds perfectly sensible: your average price is lower, so you’ll break even sooner.

But averaging down only works on your position, not your judgment. If the reason you bought was wrong, investing more just ties new money to an old mistake. Your average price looks a little better, but the mistake is still the same.

That’s the trap with sunk costs: they make you focus on the money you’ve already spent instead of asking whether it’s still worth keeping this money invested.

If your judgment was wrong, admit it first. Deciding what to do with your position comes next.

BMNR treasury update｜6.07 million ETH, about 86% staked｜Spot rebound still awaits confirmation from fund flows

My stance is to defend first, then assess whether buying support emerges. The company press release attached to Bitmine’s SEC 8-K filing on November 16 disclosed that, as of 3:00 p.m. Eastern Time on November 15, the company held 6,077,745 ETH, of which 5,227,037 had been staked, representing about 86% of its ETH holdings; it also held approximately $448 million in cash and marketable securities. The company said it purchased 7,653 ETH the previous week. This “purchase” is backed by a formal disclosure, but the balance as of November 15 is not today’s real-time on-chain balance, and it does not justify claiming that the company continued adding to its holdings on November 20.

This has two implications for ETH. Long-term corporate holdings and staking reduce the immediate willingness to circulate these assets and give the company the prospect of staking rewards. But concentrated holdings also expose a listed company’s balance sheet to amplified ETH price volatility, so the market will also watch its financing capacity, cash buffer, and exit arrangements. Staked does not mean permanently locked; withdrawals and unstaking remain subject to protocol and operational processes. The company’s estimates of future returns are forward-looking judgments, not realized income. I care more about whether new buying can continue than about treating a one-time disclosure of existing holdings as a signal to buy every hour.

For now, the market has not immediately strengthened in response to this treasury data. At the time of observation, ETH/USDT on Binance was around $1,750, down about 3.10% over 24 hours, with an intraday low of about $1,718 and a high of about $1,818. Farside’s U.S. spot ETH fund table for November 19 showed net outflows of $131.2 million, from a separate institutional funding channel. This uses a different basis from Bitmine’s corporate holdings, so the figures cannot be subtracted to derive net buying or selling across the entire market, nor can fund outflows be equated directly with spot selling in individual trades at that time. ETH appeared on Binance Square’s six-hour search rankings, but I saw no trending topic directly tied to this Bitmine disclosure, so I won’t invent a trending hashtag.

My key levels are $1,718, $1,750, $1,780, and $1,818. If the price holds above $1,718 and returns above $1,780, that would suggest short-term selling pressure may be getting absorbed. If $1,718 breaks and the price closes below it, the short-term stabilization thesis is invalidated. Even if the price returns to $1,780, a continued deterioration in fund flows or the company’s next formal filing showing a reduction in its treasury would weaken the bullish interpretation.

If I were trading this myself: I would stay out for now, and would only consider a small spot long, with no leverage. Only if ETH regains and holds $1,780, retests it without breaking below, and fund data no longer deteriorates significantly would I enter in two tranches, using no more than 5% of total capital. The first target is $1,818 and the second is $1,860. I would take half off at $1,818 and move the stop on the rest up to around the entry price. I would stop out if the price falls below $1,740; if it breaks below $1,718 before entry, I would cancel the plan. If a formal disclosure contradicts the assumption about the company’s holdings, or if the rebound lacks volume and cannot hold above $1,780, I would close the position and reassess. Conditions that have not yet been triggered must not be described as completed trades or profits.
